messages:
alex: FYI opened docs PR to fix generate endpoint header casing and curl vs SDK examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345
tara: thanks! can you paste the exact header mismatch? quick glance shows `X-Request-Id` vs `x-request-id` in examples
alex: root cause: old curl examples used `X-Request-Id` but SDKs pass `x-request-id`; backend is case-insensitive but examples confuse users. PR updates curl + python + go snippets.
sam: do we need a migration note? some customers parse headers case-sensitively in proxies
alex: good point — adding a short "breaking examples" note in the docs PR and a compat tip: prefer lower-case `x-request-id` in SDK examples
tara: can you include the corrected snippets here? i want to copy to the cookbook
alex: sure — curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{"model":"rwkv-1","input":"hello"}'
```
alex: python snippet updated to set `headers={\"x-request-id\": request_id}`
docs-ci-bot: docs lint passed — examples validated against openapi (checks/examples): ✅
sam: looks good. can we add a short note in changelog about SDK snippet parity? :memo:
tara: also please update the Go example to use http.Header.Set("x-request-id", id)
alex: added both changes + changelog entry. small merge conflict with main (openapi example ordering). i'll rebase and ping when green.
kevin: if tests blow up in the release branch, prefer reverting the curl example first and ship changelog later :+1:
alex: noted. will coordinate with release team. thanks everyone :rocket:
